paras: Protect your engine by preventing excessive crankcase oil vapor entering the intake and carbon build up with LEYO Oil Catch Can Kit. Also known as blow-by, oil vapor is produced under load, spirited driving elevates oil vapor level at an incredible rate, it is then circulated back into the intake tract resulting in carbon buildup of the intake valve, trapped oil residuals in both intake tract and intercooler. Unfiltered recirculated oil vapor will not only diminish performance, but also impose devastating effect to the engine.

The LEYO Oil Catch Can Kit V3 is made from high-grade aluminum, ensuring rust-free and leak-free operation. The newly improved PCV plate offers enhanced stability, offering you peace of mind while driving. The kit also includes a pre-installed drain valve, making it easier than ever to protect your pride and joy.
hl: Oil Level Check - Built-in dipstick for easy and quick oil level checks.
Superior Filtration - Designed with multi-layer perforated stainless teel plates for excellent filtration.
Premium Construction - Made from high-grade T6061 aluminium for a refund appearance and leak-free operation.
Drain Plug - Bottom drain plug allows for easy disposal.
ft: Oil Catch Can Kit V3 - Audi A3 8V / Volkswagen Golf GTI MK7/7.5
